review_notes:
Touchcadence is a single-player practice app for tapping precision, reaction speed, rhythm and movement control. A target travels along a set path and the user taps it before it expires.

- No account, login, or registration is required, so no demo credentials are needed.
- Single-player and entirely offline. Exercises, results and settings stay on the device.
- No in-app purchases, no ads, no user-generated content, no social features.

How to use (for quick evaluation):
1. From "Home", tap "Training Library" and pick an exercise — "Circle Tempo Drill" is short and easy.
2. The detail screen previews the path the target will follow. Tap "Start Session"; a three-second countdown runs first.
3. Tap the moving disc. A hit raises score and combo; a tap on empty space, or letting the ring around the target run out, resets the combo to zero.
4. When time ends the result screen grades the run from D to SSS, splits it into accuracy, reaction, combo, rhythm and stability, and names the weakest one to work on.
5. "Free Practice" drills any of the fifteen movement paths for one to five minutes without scoring pressure.

All exercises are built in and every calculation happens on the device.
